rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for an illness, disease, or generally being in bad health.

example.english: I've been dealing with illness a lot lately.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 seng4 jat6 beng6

rows.note: Use this when referring to a particular episode or bout of illness rather than ill health in general.

example.english: I've just got through a bout of illness.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ngaam1 ngaam1 ngaai4 jyun4 jat1 coeng4 beng6
